what: Pressing prev or next slides the whole card row by one slot (card width 100%) in .6s cubic-bezier(.58,.21,.41,.96). Once it has moved, the end card is sent to the opposite end (css order, document order unchanged) so it loops endlessly. One card is also pre-placed on the left so no gap shows when going back, and pressing again mid-slide queues one more move after it finishes. This is the News row of the Studio carousel

options.dur: Duration per slot (sec), default .6 — 0 moves instantly
options.--fx-lead: Row left margin (css variable) — to center a card use calc((100% - card width) / 2)
options.delay: Delay before sliding after press (s), default 0
options.every: Interval in seconds to advance to the next cell automatically, default 0 (off). Pressing restarts the count from then · Brand feature card row 5
options.pause: On hover, auto-advance pauses while the pointer is over it and restarts counting from the beginning on leave (STUDIO carousel mouseenter·mouseleave), by default it does not pause
options.start: In view mode, auto-advance (every) counts from when the panel first enters the screen — after that it keeps running even off screen (like the Studio carousel waking up when first seen). By default it counts right on attach
